rows.text_1_facilitator:
There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.

2️⃣ Today, you will learn about Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.

text_1_facilitator.eng:
There are four steps to building a family budget. 💰You have already covered:
1️⃣ Step 1: identifying needs and wants.

2️⃣ Today, you will learn about Step 2: talking about monthly expenses.

text_2.eng:
🔑 Knowing what your family’s monthly expenses are can be helpful for everyone in your family. 

💡 It can help them understand why money is being spent on some things and not on others.

rows.text_2:

💡 It can help them understand why money is being spent on some things and not on others.

rows.text_1_facilitator: Let's get started with an activity!

text_1_facilitator.eng: Let's get started with an activity!

text_2.eng: 📝 Get a piece of paper (or old newspaper or a cardboard box) and a pen.

rows.text_2: 📝 Get a piece of paper (or old newspaper or a cardboard box) and a pen.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 🎨 Draw pictures of all the things that you and your family spend money on each month.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 🎨 Draw pictures of all the things that you and your family spend money on each month.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 📝 Write next to each picture how much each thing costs.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 📝 Write next to each picture how much each thing costs.

rows.text_1_facilitator: 💰 Add up how much money you have to spend each month.

text_1_facilitator.eng: 💰 Add up how much money you have to spend each month.

text_2.eng: Take a picture of the paper or save it for your next lesson! ⭐

rows.text_2: Take a picture of the paper or save it for your next lesson! ⭐

rows.text_1_facilitator: 5️⃣ Here are the five steps to talk about your monthly expenses!

text_1_facilitator.eng: 5️⃣ Here are the five steps to talk about your monthly expenses!

section_1_text.eng:
📝 With your family, make a list of things that you cannot live without. These are things that are important for your family to survive. 
⭐ For example: food 🍚, medicine 🩹, or laundry detergent 🫧.

section_2_text.eng:
🎁 Make a list of things that you or others want. These are things that would be nice to have but not essential. 
⭐ For example: the latest version of a smartphone 📱, new toy 🧸, or a new car 🚗.

section_3_text.eng:
👀 People often see things in different ways. 
📝 You may find that your family members see one thing as a NEED while you see it as a WANT. 
💰 Talk with your family about why you feel differently. This will help you to understand each other and can make decisions together about what to spend money on.
